| Chest radiograph | Pulmonary consolidation, cavitations, effusions | Upper lobe cavitations (TB); lobar consolidation (pneumonia) |
An elderly patient with known HIV presents with a persistent cough, weight loss, and a chest X‑ray showing upper‑lobe cavitation.
The crucial point: upper-lobe cavitation suggests TB but does not prove it.
